comparison.objective: Move four visually identical sealed cups with hidden, different weights without crushing or dropping them.
comparison.physical_skill: Adaptive grip-force selection from sensed load and damage-aware upright transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Each cup is side-wall grasped, lifted, placed upright on a tray, released, and never buckled, dropped, or excessively tilted.
comparison.reason: PR-2001 tests per-object grip-force adaptation under hidden mass. The candidate tests two-handed manipulation of one screen to separate two loose-body classes through physical holes while preserving retained workpieces.
